title: Kissed By Light Tunisian Meat Pilaf
description: A light and flavorful Tunisian dish featuring shredded meat, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner. The combination of tangy flavors and gooey cheese is sure to please.

ingredients.name: ground lamb
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works best for this dish

ingredients.name: chicken broth
ingredients.notes: make sure it's hot before adding to the dutch oven

ingredients.name: grated cheese
ingredients.notes: Parmesan or Asiago work well here

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat until it shimmers.
Add the ground lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it's no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and minced garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 20 minutes, then remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the liquid has been mostly absorbed and the meat is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the grated cheese until it's melted and gooey.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped parsley or cilantro if desired.
Serve hot, with crusty bread or over couscous if desired.
